name: @equationalapplications/expo-llm-wiki
description: LLM Wiki Memory for Expo/React Native. Backward-compat alias for @eq/wiki-expo.

scripts.build: pnpm -r build && tsup src/index.ts src/react/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --external react --external expo-sqlite --external @eq/wiki-core --external @eq/wiki-expo --external @eq/wiki-react --out-dir dist
scripts.dev:root: tsup src/index.ts src/react/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --external react --external expo-sqlite --external @eq/wiki-core --external @eq/wiki-expo --external @eq/wiki-react --out-dir dist --watch
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const procs = [spawn('pnpm', ['run', 'dev:root'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }), spawn('pnpm', ['run', 'dev:workspace'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true })]; let done = false; const stop = (signal) => { for (const p of procs) { if (!p.killed) p.kill(signal); } }; const finish = (code) => { if (done) return; done = true; stop('SIGTERM'); process.exit(code ?? 0); }; process.on('SIGINT', () => finish(130)); process.on('SIGTERM', () => finish(143)); for (const p of procs) p.on('exit', (code) => finish(code));"
